name: dm-preview
description: Preview MapLibre output generated by dm-converter

scripts.check: find bin src static scripts -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' | xargs -n1 node --check
scripts.generate:symbol-assets: node scripts/generate-symbol-assets.mjs && npm run normalize:pen-styles && npm run generate:maplibre-assets
scripts.build: bun build --compile bin/dm-preview.js --outfile dist/dm-preview && node scripts/build.mjs
